evals.name: discount-pattern-digest-eval-1
evals.expected_output: The overall median is 14 across 9 deals. Priya has a median of 30 across 3 deals, 16 above the overall median, so she is a pattern. Sam (median 14) and Jordan (median 12) are not. Outliers are Dunmore Retail (35), Elm Logistics (30) and Birch Analytics (28), all at least 24. The digest says it does not link discounts to wins or losses.
expectations: Every section in the rubric is present, in order
Every claim cites a quote, a timestamp, or a column and cell
Anything the input does not say is written as not stated, not guessed
No fact from outside the input appears
A rep claim that the other side never accepted is not written as agreed
The overall median 14 is computed from nine rows
Priya is named as a pattern with three deals behind it
Sam and Jordan are not named as patterns
The three outliers are listed with cited cells
The digest states it does not link discounts to wins or losses

evals.name: discount-pattern-digest-eval-2-thin-input
evals.prompt: run discount-pattern-digest on a very short input that supports only one or two items
evals.expected_output: The output is short and does not invent items to fill the sections. Missing items are written as not stated.
expectations: The output does not pad to reach a count
Missing information is written as not stated
